_comment: A lord's commission (docs/LIVING_WORLD_2.md §8): weight 0, so no board posts it; offered by rank in the lord's or steward's conversation and bound to the domain's real state by the 'commission' block (quest/commission/Binder).

objectives.label: Put his lordship's letter in the hand of {recipient} of {target}

title: A letter to {target}
His lordship's seal
Word for the lord of {target}
summary: Carry a sealed letter from the lord of {settlement} to the lord of {target}, {distance} to the {direction}, and put it in their hand.
A letter under his lordship's seal, for the lord of {target}. Nobody else may open it.
Take his lordship's letter to {target}, {direction} of here, and give it to their lord yourself.
offer: This letter goes to the lord of {target}, {distance} {direction}. Into their hand, nobody else's. Can you be trusted with that?
His lordship writes to {target}. You will carry it, and you will not lose it.
A letter for the lord of {target}. Seal unbroken, delivered by your own hand.
progress: Is the letter in the right hands?
complete: Delivered, seal whole. That is the beginning of trust.
The lord of {target} has it. His lordship thanks you.
